Audited all 41 Roman verses against the Urdu in [mai-jee-ke-kya-karoo.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/1590e301b2e044a1a5057fe930147349/src/data/lyrics/mai-jee-ke-kya-karoo.md). Corrected transliteration and the Roman title, verified one-to-one verse alignment, and confirmed the Urdu body is byte-for-byte unchanged.

The readings `Ye aa gaya haiṅ` and `Shak ho ke` follow the written source and remain open to editorial review.
